svg.title: Shared process: one host program holds every plugin
svg.desc: One host process, omx-clap-host or mod-host, holds omx-comp, omx-delay and omx-drive. Each plugin is a JACK client of its own inside that process, and the host links them in series through JACK, from the sine source to the playback ports.
